description: Start a durable analysis across the session sources. exhaustive processes every eligible interview; quick retrieves verified evidence through document search; aggregate computes exact counts; explore runs bounded computation. Poll get_research_analysis. Prefer chat_research_session or queue_research_chat for questions and generate_research_output for saved outputs. Completed or partial runs can produce presentations, clips or reels; retain coverage and limitations. Reuse the idempotency key on uncertain retries.

call_budget.description: Maximum number of interviews to analyze in this run.

codebook.description: Coding labels to apply when analyzing interview evidence.

group_by.description: Field or audience dimension used to group the analysis findings.

idempotency_key.description: Use a stable key for this operation and reuse it on retries with the same inputs.

include_synthetic.description: Include evidence from synthetic respondents alongside human interviews.

mode.description: Analysis strategy to use for this question.

organization_id.description: Organization for this operation and billing. Use list_organizations to choose an active membership.

output_name.description: Display name for the output generated by this analysis.

output_type.description: Format of the result generated by the analysis.

parent_run_id.description: Existing analysis run to use as the basis for this run.

question.description: Research question to answer using evidence from the selected studies.

session_id.description: UUID of the research session, as returned by inspect_research_session.

name: start_research_analysis
title: Start Research Analysis
